items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Well, I could do single string stuff that Sid couldn't do.

ctx.x: You know, Sid Pritikon told me that you could play the guitar just about as well as he could and he was the band's guitar player---
Well, I could do single string stuff that Sid couldn't do. You know, a lot of -technical, jazzy
stuff, but - uh - it was--- well, I thought I was in heaven. To meet all the great stars and work with the great stars and I remember---
